subject.title: fix(doctor): skip cleanup hints for active gateway and downgrade exec SecretRef errors to warnings

question: Should doctor SecretRef degradation be implemented as a command-local read-only inspection path while keeping exported strict SecretRef helpers strict?
rationale: The PR touches a CODEOWNERS security surface and the generated plugin SDK baseline, so automation should not decide whether a process-wide doctor env flag is an acceptable credential-boundary design.

options.title: Keep strict helpers strict
options.body: Use existing read-only SecretRef result/safe probe patterns in doctor call sites and remove the exported doctor-specific leniency surface.

options.title: Approve the new leniency API
options.body: Allow the exported helper and generated SDK baseline to grow doctor-specific behavior after secops signs off and compatibility tests are added.

options.title: Replace the branch
